title: Verify Windows production registration in the user's actual host context
acceptance: A packaged caller must not report a real host installation when only its virtualized view can launch the release.
A fresh unpackaged process must resolve the expected installed entry, verify the package identity and launch the accepted version without human configuration.
Preserve existing processes, unrelated PATH entries and the prior verified release. Retain failure evidence if the host cannot be reached.

host_handoff_probe.action: Run the admitted package directly with install-release --status --expect and its release ID
host_handoff_probe.scope: Read-only host status under parallel build load.

development_binary_handoff.wrong_release_worker_receipt: installed release differs from the requested target
development_binary_handoff.deep_path_fixture: A 264-character executable path reproduced Windows error 3. The corrected version probe and installation interruption/rollback/tamper suite passed in this same scratch layout.
development_binary_handoff.interactive_fixture_aba: 6.51 seconds including fixture compilation. An explicitly verified packaged parent scheduled three ordinary user processes through the product handoff. Each applied a transition to a private channel. The parent independently launched A, B, and restored A. The fixture omits real PATH and shortcut registration.
development_binary_handoff.client_termination: Killed the packaged status client after observing its registered task. The ordinary worker verified the exact installed 0.21.42 release, removed its own registration and left its result for recovery. A fresh client retried successfully. Combined interruption and retry took 2785 ms.
development_binary_handoff.self_removal_fixture_aba: 5.39 seconds including fixture compilation. Registration started each worker exactly once and each worker released its working directory before publishing the result.
development_binary_handoff.scheduler_origin: A packaged client pointed SystemRoot, WINDIR, and PATH to a private directory containing a decoy schtasks.exe. The decoy never executed. The real worker verified the expected installed release and the client exited zero in 5267 ms. An earlier observer timed out before recording a result.
development_binary_handoff.verified_machine_root_checks: Strict Clippy succeeded for the Susi binary and susi-harness targets. All 73 regular CLI tests passed. The separate interactive A-B-A fixture passed in 11.22s and the native shortcut/expandable PATH idempotence test passed.
development_binary_handoff.scope: Packaged development caller, ordinary Windows host worker, read-only real release status and isolated fixture A-B-A. End-to-end installation and rollback of qualified packages with real registration through a packaged caller remain open.
